sources: https://www.reservevaparks.com/Web/#!park/6 (US eDirect API prod-va-rdr.recreation-management.tylerapp.com: search/place for PlaceId 6, and search/grid + search/details for every unit of facility 36 Birch Campground and 38 Dogwood Campground, start date 2027-05-04, read 2026-10-21)

hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/claytor-lake ('Birch Campground: Water and electric hookups; sites accept outlets for 20, 30, 50 amp current', 'Dogwood Campground: Water and electric hookups; sites accept outlets for 20, 30 amp current', 'There are no sewer hook-ups') + reservevaparks.com site details (all 28 Birch electric/water sites list Electric Hookup 50; Dogwood's 39 list 30-amp electric and Water Hookup), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 103 campsites: 67 electric/water (39 in Dogwood, RVs to 40 ft, 22 of them pull-through on the booking site; 28 in Birch, to 30 ft, back-in on the booking site though DCR says 'some pull-through available') and 36 no-hookup sites in Alder and Cedar for tents and small trailers to 20 ft. One axled camper per site. DCR prefers units up to 30 ft to use Birch. Alder and its bunkhouse open only Memorial Day-Labor Day.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/claytor-lake ('Total sites of each type : STD, 36; E/W, 67', 'Total campsites : 103', 'large RV units up to 40 feet', 'Most large RV sites are pull-through') + reservevaparks.com search/details per site (Dogwood: VehicleLength 40, 22 Pull Through; Birch: VehicleLength 30, all Back In), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Dump station in Cedar Campground. No laundry in the park: 'The closest laundromat is three miles from the park.' Generators are not permitted in the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/claytor-lake ('a bathhouse with running water and hot showers', 'there is a dump station in Cedar Campground', 'LAUNDRY: The closest laundromat is three miles from the park in the Lancer Travel Plaza', 'Generators are not permitted in the campground'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'All sites are site-specific.' Reserve online or at 800-933-PARK. The park page also says 'Some campsites may be specifically reserved and others are first-come, first-served', which contradicts it, so walk-up use is not recorded. Check-in 4 p.m., check-out 1 p.m. The booking site gives a 14-night maximum on every campsite.

booking.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/claytor-lake ('you can reserve online or call 800-933-PARK (7275)', 'All sites are site-specific', 'Check-in is 4 p.m. and check-out is 1 p.m.') + reservevaparks.com search/details ('MaxStay': 14 on all Birch and Dogwood units), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed the $37 electric/water rate on the booking site (fees left as human-checked 2026-10-12), season already manual and matching ('first Friday in March until the first Monday in December'), reservable with a 14-night max. Added 50-amp (Birch) electric with water, no sewer, 103 sites to 40 ft with pull-throughs, showers/dump, no laundry. Not stated for this park: booking window or cutoff (left inherited), fcfs (the page contradicts itself).
